movie.title: Secret of Kalinga
movie.overview: A college sits on ancient Kalinga kingdom land. Behind it, a forest well holds a princess's spirit, imprisoned centuries ago. Students accidentally break the seal on New Year's Eve, triggering comedic chaos.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When college students accidentally release the imprisoned spirit of an ancient princess on New Year's Eve, chaos and supernatural comedy erupt across their campus.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Built upon the ancient grounds of the Kalinga kingdom, a modern college conceals a dark history deep within its neighboring forest. A centuries-old well traps the vengeful spirit of an ancient princess, keeping the area safe from supernatural mischief. However, a group of unsuspecting students accidentally breaks the seal during a wild New Year's Eve celebration. Suddenly, the campus is thrown into a hilarious blend of horror and comedic turmoil as the students attempt to contain the spirit.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Centuries ago, a princess of the ancient Kalinga kingdom was bound to a sacred well in the forest to protect the surrounding lands. In the present day, a bustling college stands right on the edge of these historical, cursed grounds. The students remain entirely unaware of the magical barrier holding the spirit at bay until a chaotic New Year's Eve party leads a group into the woods. Through sheer carelessness, the partygoers inadvertently shatter the mystical seal encasing the well, releasing the princess's spirit into the modern world. Instead of immediate doom, the spirit's presence manifests as a series of bizarre, supernatural phenomena that turn student life upside down. As terrifying moments quickly devolve into slapstick comedy, a small group of friends realizes they are responsible for the breach. They must navigate local folklore, quirky professors, and campus drama to figure out a way to appease the spirit. Racing against time before the ghost's power grows permanent, the students devise a chaotic plan to reseal the well. Ultimately, their terrifying yet hilarious ordeal teaches them to respect the ancient secrets buried beneath their feet.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of a modern college campus built on the historic grounds of the Kalinga kingdom, this horror-comedy follows a group of students whose New Year's Eve festivities go wildly awry. Deep within the nearby forest lies a forgotten well that holds the long-imprisoned spirit of an ancient princess. When the students unwittingly breach the sacred seal keeping the entity contained, the campus becomes ground zero for supernatural disturbances, blending eerie folklore with laugh-out-loud comedy as the group struggles to fix their mistake.

story_structure.climax: A chaotic showdown takes place on campus grounds where the students must perform a high-stakes ritual to calm the ancient spirit before the magical mayhem becomes irreversible.
story_structure.conflict: During a New Year's Eve celebration, the students inadvertently disturb the forest well and break its ancient seal, releasing the long-imprisoned spirit of a Kalinga princess.
story_structure.resolution: Peace is restored to the college, the ancient realm's balance is reset, and the students reflect on a wild New Year's Eve with a newfound respect for local legends.
story_structure.introduction: The story establishes a modern college campus built upon the ancient grounds of the Kalinga kingdom, introducing the student protagonists and the lore surrounding a forgotten, sealed forest well.
story_structure.risingAction: The spirit unleashes comedic, supernatural chaos across the campus while the students scramble to learn about ancient Kalinga history and find a way to manage the spirit's wild antics.
